title: AI Parts Wizard
description: NL exploration of parts, duplicate match groups, suppliers, and savings.
serialized_space: {"version": 2, "instructions": {"text_instructions": [{"id": "a692268c4f774f24a6af7a4615662e45", "content": ["AI Parts Wizard finds duplicate parts bought under different part numbers across 4 plants and their models. Plants: HV0 (North Harvester Works), HV1 (South Harvester Works) build Harvesters; TR0 (East Tractor Works), TR1 (West Tractor Works) build Tractors. silver_parts: ~200K parts; part_id is the unique id; part_number is NOT globally unique so never join/group on it -- use part_id. Columns: part_category, material, description, dimensions, model_id, annual_volume (units purchased per year). silver_models: model_id -> plant_id + machine_type ('Harvester'/'Tractor'). silver_plants: plant_id -> name/location. gold_match_groups: near-duplicate clusters; group_id; savings_potential = ANNUAL savings in USD = sum over members of (member best unit price - group_best_price) x member annual_volume; total_current_spend = annual spend in USD; group_best_price = best unit price in USD; member_count; models_spanned/machine_types_spanned/plants_spanned (machine_types_spanned=2 spans harvesters AND tractors); avg_similarity (0-1). gold_match_group_members: group_id -> part_id with similarity (0-1). Join silver_parts for attrs, silver_models for machine_type/plant. silver_supplier_catalogs: per-supplier price_per_unit (USD), unit_discount, lead_time_days per part_id; join silver_suppliers for supplier_name. gold_normalized_parts/gold_review_dispositions: assigned enterprise part numbers and review status. similarity is 0-1 (95% similarity = similarity >= 0.95). Parts only match within the same part_category AND material. To answer 'harvester parts >95% similar to tractor part X': find X's group via gold_match_group_members, then its members joined to silver_models where machine_type='Harvester' and similarity >= 0.95. Example: total savings by category = SELECT part_category, round(sum(savings_potential),2) FROM gold_match_groups GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC. Cross-type groups = gold_match_groups WHERE machine_types_spanned > 1.", " Opportunity questions: 'opportunities', 'standardization opportunities', 'consolidation opportunities' or 'duplicate groups' mean rows of gold_match_groups. ALWAYS include group_id, part_category, material, member_count, plants_spanned and savings_potential in the result (group_id lets the app show the groups on the Similarity Map), order by savings_potential DESC, default LIMIT 10. 'Across the company', 'enterprise-wide' or 'across all plants' mean the whole catalog (no filter). Example: 'Show me the highest-value part standardization opportunities across the company' = SELECT group_id, part_category, material, member_count, plants_spanned, round(savings_potential,2) AS savings_potential FROM gold_match_groups ORDER BY savings_potential DESC LIMIT 10. All prices and savings are illustrative synthetic data; say so briefly when reporting dollar values."]}]}, "data_sources": {"tables": [{"identifier": "__CATALOG__.__SCHEMA__.gold_match_group_members"}, {"identifier": "__CATALOG__.__SCHEMA__.gold_match_groups"}, {"identifier": "__CATALOG__.__SCHEMA__.gold_normalized_parts"}, {"identifier": "__CATALOG__.__SCHEMA__.gold_review_dispositions"}, {"identifier": "__CATALOG__.__SCHEMA__.silver_models"}, {"identifier": "__CATALOG__.__SCHEMA__.silver_parts"}, {"identifier": "__CATALOG__.__SCHEMA__.silver_plants"}, {"identifier": "__CATALOG__.__SCHEMA__.silver_supplier_catalogs"}, {"identifier": "__CATALOG__.__SCHEMA__.silver_suppliers"}]}}
